text:
Yes. Hansen GFC (version GFC-2025-v1.13) recorded about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss within the asset in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property. The evidence supports this finding. A later year was observed (series runs to 2025), and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the event area.

Context: the MGAP 2021 forest map classes 68.1 ha of the loss as planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha as outside mapped forest, and none as native forest. Separately, Hansen shows another 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which are not counted in the 81.3 ha.

Limits: this does not show deforestation or land-use change, since Hansen loss includes plantation cutting. It also does not establish the cause, legality, responsible party, or any compliance finding, such as EUDR status.
